Recipe: 

2 cups of flour 
1/2 teaspoon baking powder 
1 1/4 cup of ripe avocado 
4 tablespoons of melted butter 
1/2 cup grated cheese (I use raw mild cheddar) 

Bake at 375 for 15 minutes 

Store in air tight container for 4-5 days. Ours never last longer than 24 hours 😋#healthysnacks #toddlerrecipe #momlife #outdoorkids #snackprep
